title: Rondout Electric
description: Rondout Electric Inc. is a leading electrical contracting company with over 50 years of experience, specializing in a wide range of projects including health care facilities, schools, industrial complexes, and public sector projects. With a dedicated team of approximately 100 employees, they are known for their disciplined approach to ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. The company has built long-standing relationships with clients who appreciate their commitment to integrity and customer satisfaction. Based in Highland, NY, Rondout Electric serves clients across the eastern part of New York State.
